styleGuide.palette: deep pitch green, cool floodlit teal shadows, warm stadium amber (#ffe066) as the single accent
styleGuide.mood: big-match night football, cinematic but readable on a small phone screen
styleGuide.rendering: clean flat vector-like game art, smooth solid surfaces, soft simple gradients, no grain, no noise, no speckle, no photographic texture, no text, no watermark

backgrounds.prompt: Vertical mobile game background, view from behind the goal looking out at a daytime training pitch. Above it: open green training pitch stretching away, faint chalk markings, a low fence and empty stands on the horizon in the upper quarter, bright overcast daylight. Clean flat vector-like art, smooth surfaces, soft gradients. The goal mouth must be COMPLETELY EMPTY — no ball, no goalkeeper, no players, no gloves anywhere in the image. ui.prompt: Game UI element: a horizontal STADIUM SCOREBOARD FRAME that FILLS THE ENTIRE FRAME edge to edge with no empty margin. A smooth rectangular plaque with slightly rounded corners touching all four image edges, a thick brushed dark-metal border of even width on all four sides, and a flat very dark inset field across the middle left completely empty. A thin warm amber (#ffe066) highlight line runs along the inner rim. The border must be the SAME thickness on all four sides and the inner field must be perfectly flat and empty. Clean flat vector-like game art, smooth surfaces. No text, no letters, no numbers, no symbols, no glow halo extending beyond the plaque.

Game UI element: a small square dark-metal PAUSE button, smooth plate with rounded corners and a warm amber (#ffe066) double-bar pause glyph centred on it, thin bevelled edge catching light. Clean flat vector-like game art, symmetrical, smooth surfaces. No text, no letters, no numbers.

fx.prompt: Game FX sprite: a sharp white impact burst — a bright compact core with a few broad radiating spikes, reading as a hard ball strike. Cool white with a faint pale blue edge. Simple bold shape, smooth surfaces, radially symmetrical. No grain, no speckle, no text.

Game FX sprite: a warm amber (#ffe066) crescent flash — a curved arc of light with a soft bloom along its inner edge, reading as a glove sweeping across and deflecting something. Simple bold curved shape, smooth gradient, open transparent centre. No grain, no speckle, no text.

Game FX sprite: a soft white SHOCK RING — one smooth thick circular ring of pale white light with a gentle outer glow and an open transparent centre, like the moment a surface absorbs a hard impact. Exactly ONE ring, no mesh, no grid, no lines crossing it, no debris. Perfectly smooth gradient from the ring outward. Clean flat vector-like game art. NO grain, NO noise, NO speckle, NO texture. No text.

Game FX sprite: a low spray of torn grass and turf — a fan of green blades and small clods kicked up sideways, deep green with a few lighter highlights. Simple bold silhouette, smooth surfaces. No grain, no speckle, no text.

Game FX sprite: a cluster of pale blue-white RAIN STREAKS — several long thin diagonal droplet trails of varying length, translucent, angled consistently. Simple clean strokes on a flat background, smooth edges. No grain, no speckle, no text.
